initiatives.name: Net Zero Carbon Emissions Strategy
initiatives.summary: Rentokil Initial has established a commitment to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2040 with clear milestones. The company is on track with targeted actions including fleet transition and renewable energy adoption.

evidence.title: Net Zero Emissions Target by 2040
evidence.summary: Rentokil Initial has established a commitment to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2040 with clear milestones. The company is on track with targeted actions including fleet transition and renewable energy adoption.
evidence.quote: We are on track to achieve net zero emissions by 2040, with targeted milestones and measurable actions to ensure consistent progress.

evidence.title: 20% Emissions Intensity Reduction Target
evidence.summary: The company has set a new emissions intensity target to achieve a 20% reduction by the end of 2025. They have already achieved 17.3% reduction in their emissions intensity index as of 2024.
evidence.quote: New emissions intensity target – 20% reduction by the end 2025... 17.3% reduction in our emissions intensity index

evidence.title: Fleet Transition to Ultra Low Emissions Vehicles
evidence.summary: Rentokil Initial has achieved its target of 10% of European and UK fleet being Ultra Low Emissions Vehicles (ULEVs). The company targets a majority of vehicles to be ULEV in UK and Europe by 2030, with 100% ULEV fleet as the ultimate goal.
evidence.quote: Target achieved: 10% of European and UK fleet is now ULEV... Target: Majority of vehicles will be ULEV in UK and Europe by 2030

evidence.title: Fumigation Emissions Reduction Program
evidence.summary: The company has achieved a 21% reduction in fumigation emissions over two years and 5% year-on-year reduction. They have set a target for 70% reduction in emissions from fumigation by 2030 using 2022 as the base year.
evidence.quote: Fumigation emissions reduced by 21% over 2 years... Target: 70% reduction in emissions from fumigation (base year 2022)

evidence.title: Renewable Energy Transition Program
evidence.summary: The company has introduced first renewable energy contracts and set a target for 90% of properties in the UK and Europe to use renewable energy by 2030. They have already implemented market-based emissions reductions through renewable electricity contracts.
evidence.quote: First renewable energy contracts introduced... Target: 90% of properties in the UK and Europe using renewable energy by 2030

initiatives.name: France Workwear Business Divestment
initiatives.summary: Rentokil Initial completed the sale of its France Workwear business for $397 million net cash proceeds on 30 September 2025. This strategic divestment reinforces the company's focus on core pest control and hygiene and wellbeing sectors.

evidence.title: France Workwear Business Divestment
evidence.summary: Rentokil Initial completed the sale of its France Workwear business for $397 million net cash proceeds on 30 September 2025. This strategic divestment reinforces the company's focus on core pest control and hygiene and wellbeing sectors.
evidence.quote: On 30 September 2025 we completed the sale of the France Workwear business for $397m. Strategically this divestment reinforces our focus on our core pest control and hygiene and wellbeing sectors and financially it increases our cash generation going forwards, reducing our capital expenditure needs and improving our cash conversion ratio.

initiatives.name: Global Acquisition Program – Pest Control & Hygiene
initiatives.summary: In 2025, Rentokil Initial acquired 36 businesses comprising 31 in Pest Control and 5 in Hygiene & Wellbeing for total consideration of $115 million. The acquired businesses had revenues of approximately $63 million in the year prior to purchase.

evidence.title: Global Acquisition Program Continues
evidence.summary: In 2025, Rentokil Initial acquired 36 businesses comprising 31 in Pest Control and 5 in Hygiene & Wellbeing for total consideration of $115 million. The acquired businesses had revenues of approximately $63 million in the year prior to purchase.
evidence.quote: In 2025, we acquired 36 businesses, comprising 31 in Pest Control and 5 in Hygiene & Wellbeing for a total consideration of $115m. Revenues in the year prior to purchase were c.$63m.

initiatives.name: North America Cost Reduction Program
initiatives.summary: The company is implementing a cost efficiency program targeting $100 million reduction in costs by 2027 in North America compared to a 2024 inflation-adjusted base. Around $25 million of savings have already been realized in 2025 through back-office consolidation and improved procurement processes.

evidence.title: North America Cost Reduction Program
evidence.summary: The company is implementing a cost efficiency program targeting $100 million reduction in costs by 2027 in North America compared to a 2024 inflation-adjusted base. Around $25 million of savings have already been realized in 2025 through back-office consolidation and improved procurement processes.
evidence.quote: We are tracking well towards our target of a $100m reduction in costs in 2027 in our North America business compared to a 2024 inflation-adjusted base. During the year we have moved some back-office functions to Global Capability Centres, improved our discipline around procurement to better leverage our scale purchasing power, and improved productivity with the use of technology and automation. In the year, we have realised around $25m of the total and have ambitious plans in place for the future to deliver the full $100m.

initiatives.name: Net Zero 2040 Transition Plan
initiatives.summary: Rentokil Initial has established a comprehensive net zero transition plan targeting net zero emissions from operations by 2040. The company achieved its 2025 target of reducing emissions intensity by 20% and reached 12.5% of fleet as ULEVs in UK and Europe.

evidence.title: Net Zero Target by 2040
evidence.summary: Rentokil Initial has established a comprehensive net zero transition plan targeting net zero emissions from operations by 2040. The company achieved its 2025 target of reducing emissions intensity by 20% and reached 12.5% of fleet as ULEVs in UK and Europe.
evidence.quote: Our pathway to net zero emissions from our operations by the end of 2040 is built around three core pillars and workstreams... 2025 target: reduce our emissions intensity by 20% – achieved • 2025 target: 10% of Europe and UK fleet to be ULEVs – achieved

initiatives.name: RatGPT Company-wide AI Platform Deployment
initiatives.summary: Rentokil Initial rolled out Gemini for Google Workspace to their 63,400 global workforce and launched their own in-house AI platform called RatGPT. In just six months, colleagues used Gemini AI over one million times, with over 100 AI agents currently in development.

evidence.title: Company-wide AI Platform RatGPT Deployment
evidence.summary: Rentokil Initial rolled out Gemini for Google Workspace to their 63,400 global workforce and launched their own in-house AI platform called RatGPT. In just six months, colleagues used Gemini AI over one million times, with over 100 AI agents currently in development.
evidence.quote: During 2025, we made great strides forward in our data capabilities, elevating the use of data and AI through the organisation down to the branch level to support decision making with the roll-out of Gemini for Google Workspace to our c.63,400 global workforce. In just six months, colleagues used Gemini AI on over one million occasions to support their work and we have launched our own in-house AI platform, known internally as RatGPT, which currently has over 100 AI agents in development to help us grow and become more efficient.

evidence.quote: The Rentokil Terminix Innovation Centre – opened in 2024 in Dallas, this facility specialises in residential pest control, including termites, vector control, and fumigation.

This demonstrates commitment to environmental sustainability in corporate communications and supports REDD carbon reduction initiatives.

initiatives.name: Mike Duffy CEO Appointment
initiatives.summary: Mike Duffy was appointed as CEO Designate on 16 February 2026 and will become Chief Executive on 16 March 2026, replacing retiring CEO Andy Ransom. Duffy brings over 25 years of leadership experience with large US businesses with similar characteristics to Rentokil Initial.

evidence.title: New CEO Mike Duffy Appointed

evidence.quote: Following a rigorous global selection process, which you can read more about on pages 94 and 109, we were delighted to appoint Mike Duffy to succeed Andy as our new Chief Executive. Mike joined the business as CEO Designate on 16 February 2026 and will become Chief Executive on 16 March 2026.
